claims.text: This project measures one judge (  grading answers against a written rubric) against three kinds of reference kept apart: answers fixed when the test item was written, decisions published by regulators and courts, and human ratings that ship with public datasets.
Its test ads, answer keys and stored reviews are the largest family here, including the image ads, and its 46 regulator and court cases are the regulator reference.
Its "requirement met" verdicts and its 40 planted misreadings are the claim family.

| Does the judge agree with answers fixed when the items were written? | Yes, on these items: 702 of 711 verdicts (98.7%, Cohen's kappa 0.974) on ad reviews, resume verdicts and listing suggestions, 385 of 390 planted errors caught, and the same verdict three times out of three on 697 of 711. 2 of the 9 disagreements trace to the answer key, not the judge. As first run there were 12: three more came from listing-suggestion items that left out the product listing, an error in this study's items, corrected and rerun (report,  ). |
| With regulators and courts? | Less: 39 of 46 published decisions (84.8%). 33 of 35 where the decision can be read off the ad, 6 of 11 where it turned on evidence the ad does not show. |

| With human ratings that ship with public datasets? | Close on a coarse scale: on Judge's Verdict it agrees with each annotator 67.3% of the time, inside the annotators' own range of 62.5% to 67.5%. Moderate on summary quality: SummEval Spearman 0.408 (fluency) to 0.682 (consistency). Weak on translation severity: WMT MQM weighted kappa 0.290. |

| What should a script check, and what a judge? |   script: quotes that are not verbatim, figures not in the quote, unknown clause ids, malformed records. The judge caught all 145 of these too, but the script costs nothing.   judge: clear-cut objective errors (wrong decision, wrong clause, misread resume, invented property), at least 96.3% caught on every such type. People: ratings where annotators disagree, and decisions that turn on outside evidence. |

| Rules, then a judge, then a queue? | Rules first, one judgment, and the judgments marked unsure to a review queue missed 2 of 390 errors with 6.9% of items queued, against 7 of 390 for the judge alone, and cost less (0.244 against 0.304 USD per 1,000 items). The judge's unsure flag is a real signal: 0.5% of its sure judgments were wrong, 20.4% of its unsure ones. |

claims.text: 它的 46 个监管和法院案例是“监管裁决”这一种参照。
它的“符合要求”判断和 40 条植入的看错意思，是这里的 claim 组。

| 裁判和出题时定好的答案一致吗？ | 在这些题上一致：广告审核意见、简历判断、卖点修改建议共 711 道，702 道一致（98.7%，Cohen's kappa 0.974）；植入的 390 处错误抓到 385 处；711 道里 697 道三次判得一样。9 处不一致里有 2 处是答案本身的问题，不是裁判的问题。第一次跑时是 12 处：多出的 3 处来自修改建议题没给裁判商品页，是本项目建题的错，已更正并重跑（报告 ）。 |
| 和监管机构、法院的结论一致吗？ | 差一些：46 个公开结论里一致 39 个（84.8%）。能从广告本身看出结论的 35 个里对 33 个；结论取决于广告以外证据的 11 个里只对 6 个。 |
| 和公开数据集自带的人工评分一致吗？ | 粗粒度的打分接近：Judge's Verdict 上，裁判和每位标注员的一致率是 67.3%，落在标注员彼此之间的 62.5% 到 67.5% 之内。摘要质量中等：SummEval 的 Spearman 从 0.408（流畅度）到 0.682（事实一致）。翻译错误的轻重判断弱：WMT MQM 加权 kappa 0.290。 |
| 哪些交给脚本，哪些交给裁判？ | 脚本：引文不是原话、数字不在引文里、条款编号不存在、记录格式不对。这 145 处裁判也全抓到了，但脚本不花钱、也不会错。裁判：有事实可依的客观错误（结论判反、条款引错、看错简历、编造商品属性），每一类都抓到 96.3% 以上。人：标注员之间本来就有分歧的评分，以及要靠外部证据才能定的结论。 |
| 规则、裁判、复核队列一起用效果如何？ | 先跑规则，再判一次，裁判自己标“拿不准”的进复核队列：390 处错误漏掉 2 处，6.9% 的题进队列；只用裁判漏掉 7 处。前一种还更便宜（每 1,000 道 0.244 美元对 0.304 美元），因为规则先拦下的不用再调模型。裁判的“拿不准”很有用：它说“确定”的判断错 0.5%，说“拿不准”的错 20.4%。 |
